text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah briefs his cabinet on the results of the Gulf Arab countries summit held in Qatar.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange to list Securities Group share.
- Developing countries need to review their trade regulations, says commerce and industry minister.
- Kuwait beats South Korea at Asia cup soccer tournament.
- Emir hails solid Gulf Arabs position on former occupier Iraq.
- Kuwait Airways Corporation ran 1,016 flights in November.
